scope: Read-only source audit. No VM operation, source/release edit, interruption, test, or data regrade.

verdict.mainControls: A candidate-only B2 literal/helper hash change does not invalidate unchanged main A/A under current validation. Preserve old release bytes, reports, raw arm seals and all measured identities.
verdict.companionControls: Current V4 rejects prior qualification/AAs after the dependency/orchestrator hashes change. The noise mathematics remains unchanged; the wrapper's strict current-executable identity equality rejects reuse.
verdict.minimumProspectiveFix: Freeze a candidate-neutral validator before companion A/A. Use the exact authorized release's B2 descriptor as the source pin, retaining actual receipt/Git/stamp/native/inventory checks and rejecting B0/B1 as B2. Later reviewed candidate registration is data only; helper/orchestrator bytes remain stable.

bindings.finding: B2 revision is hardcoded to75; the same check exists in the companion dependency.
harnessFields contains driver/protocol/comparator/inventory-helper/document/lock/gates/workload/mode/version; excludes orchestrator SHA and B2 candidate pin.
Each current stage verifies its own released orchestrator SHA.
An active stage continually checks its original release and executable bytes. Do not mutate the running V3 file.
Prior main reports bind comparison identity, fixed B0/B1 revisions and artifact inventories. Prior A/A candidate role equals its own baseline; unrelated future B2 pin is not consulted.
Frozen noise binds exact file/SHA, baseline source/inventories, workload, comparator, gates and suitability, not orchestrator SHA.

comparator.finding: Each role has its own qualified native hash and within-role stability. Driver measured bytes/lock stay matched; noise comparison binds baseline native/full inventory, fixed measurement and comparator/gates. No orchestrator SHA binding exists.

bindings.finding: Release must match the hardcoded dependency H5SHA.
Series identity includes h5HelperSha256 AND orchestratorSha256, alongside frozen driver/files/workload/precision/runtime checks.
readSeries deep-equals every prior series identity to the CURRENT identity. Changing the dependency's B2 literal therefore blocks prior series.
Historical owner release and its identity must also match its preserved series; editing old identities is not a valid migration.
All prior series, including qualification and both A/As, are re-read before later stages.
Noise bytes are pinned and independently recomputed from sealed raw arms.

protocol.finding: Numeric noise binds baseline variant, fixed workload/precision, five pairs/ten raw arms, chronology and recomputed metrics. Candidate revision and orchestration hashes are not part of this mathematical noise envelope; the wrapper adds their execution-identity restriction.

prospectiveDisposition: Let the current main V3 A/A finish with its exact original source/release. Prepare successor helpers offline and stage only at a quiet boundary.

Remove the candidate literal once in new immutable helper sources. The exact authorized B2 descriptor remains pinned to its actual qualified receipt, clean source, build stamp, full inventories, native input/config/metadata/target/hash and within-role stability.
Keep frozen B0/B1 descriptors, driver73/V4a89, workload/oracle/timers, comparator/gates, runtime settings, precision and all raw/noise bytes unchanged.
Use one fresh companion functional qualification under the new stable helper/orchestrator identity before either companion A/A. Preserve the old V3 qualification under its own identity.
Select and seal any future actual candidate before its treatment stages. This does not authorize relabelling completed candidate comparisons.
completedCandidateLimit: Main line381 checks prior treatment candidateRevision against the currently registered B2; finalization793 binds measured descriptors. Companion141 revalidates old B2 arms against the registered build. Existing fixed stage paths also refuse overwrites (main742, companion220). A measured/failed candidate must remain its own record; this audit proposes no retrospective migration or retry framework.
parentDecision: Parent confirmed: main V3 A/A continues unchanged; new candidate-neutral V4 helpers will be frozen before companion A/A, with one fresh companion qualification. All four A/A gates still precede any further product optimization.
